name: google-cloud
description: Work with Google Cloud through the gcloud CLI: project inventory, the Cloud Storage substrate, and publishing artifacts to durable URLs.

interface.shortDescription: gcloud, Cloud Storage, and artifact publishing
interface.longDescription: Reach Google Cloud through the gcloud CLI rather than a curated connector: which projects exist and what each is for, the three-bucket Cloud Storage substrate and its write boundary, and a bundled CLI for publishing local artifacts to durable public URLs.
